snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage – Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Virtua Fighter hits Nintendo Switch 2 on March 26! Pre-Order Now!

Bring the fight with you anywhere as Virtua Fighter makes its Nintendo debut! Master every bone-crunching strike, throw, and combo across a variety of modes, including the all new single-player experience: "World Stage"

Then take on any challenger from across the globe with Cross Play and Rollback Netcode support or sharpen your skills using newly enhanced Training and Replay tools designed for fighters of all levels.

 

Available in both Physical with an exclusive double-sided poster packed in, and Digital formats

 

Pre-Order Now: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage | SEGA

Official X (Twitter) https://x.com/vf_official

Official Website https://virtua-fighter.com/revo/jp/

Official Discord Community Server / discord Join the community for the latest updates and player interaction!
